query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!" FROM feed_deliveries fd LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.id = fd.document_id AND d.user_id = fd.user_id LEFT JOIN library_entries le ON le.user_id = fd.user_id AND le.document_id = d.id AND le.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE fd.user_id = $1 AND fd.seen_at IS NULL AND fd.dismissed_at IS NULL AND fd.hidden_at IS NULL AND le.id IS NULL
